bioAdditions: WikiTree (Stecher-38, a GEDCOM import citing Find a Grave memorial 78699319) gives Christopher Stacher/Stecher as son of Johann Melchior Stecher and Anna Eva Christina (Kauffmann) Stecher, born 1749/50 in Bucks County. It says he died 15 Jun 1831 in Washington County, PA, and was buried at the Dutch Lutheran Cemetery, Ginger Hill. It names his wife as 'Elizabeth Brotzman or Doll' (S1). The wife's profile (Doll-526, b. Apr 1753, d. 4 May 1829) is an unsourced 2015 GEDCOM import from an Ancestry tree (S2).

conflicts.siteValue: Elizabeth Doll (daughter of Johann Casper Doll)
conflicts.assessment: Uncertain. Her Doll identity, and so this couple's link to Casper Doll, rests on an unsourced Ancestry-tree import. A move to Washington Co. also takes this couple away from the Forks Twp. Stechers who married into the Grubs.

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Vital data from Find a Grave via WikiTree; the Doll marriage is questioned by the same source.
